patterns.note: The page uses distinct, full-width color-blocked sections that stack vertically, creating clear visual breaks between content areas.
A very large, bold serif font is used for primary headings and hero statements, creating a strong, editorial voice, contrasted with a clean sans-serif for body text.
The site employs a high-contrast, limited palette of white, a specific shade of red/pink, and a light yellow, used for large background blocks.

The initial hero text (site title and main headline) remains fixed or has a very slow parallax effect, staying in view for a significant portion of the scroll, while subsequent content sections slide up from the bottom to cover it.
The 'Selected Work' section utilizes an accordion-style interaction to reveal project details, maintaining a clean layout until interaction.

technique_notes: Sections are revealed sequentially by sliding up from the bottom of the viewport, creating a layered effect where new content covers previous content. The primary hero text and site title are fixed or have a very slow parallax, making them sticky for a portion of the initial scroll. This uses a combination of CSS positioning and scroll-triggered transforms.
Large, opinionated serif typography is used for headlines, set against clean, solid color backgrounds to maximize impact and readability. Body text uses a contrasting sans-serif for clarity.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold serif headings (~4-5x body text) create a strong statement, complemented by a legible, clean sans-serif for body copy and smaller labels.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp; all elements like buttons, input fields, and section corners maintain crisp, 90-degree angles.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy in the hero and main content sections, with generous vertical padding between blocks and within accordion items, creating a sense of spaciousness.

standout: This site stands out with its bold, almost confrontational, serif typography in the hero section, which delivers a strong brand message. The minimalist layout, combined with stark color blocking and a sticky hero text effect, creates a distinctive editorial and confident aesthetic that avoids generic marketing tropes.
